scripts.deploy:seppuku: node scripts/check-release.mjs seppuku && wrangler deploy --config seppuku/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:seppuku-preview: node scripts/check-release.mjs seppuku --env preview && wrangler deploy --config seppuku/wrangler.jsonc --env preview
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply meme-analytics --local --config seppuku/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply meme-analytics --remote --config seppuku/wrangler.jsonc
